mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student WHERE is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class WHERE is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance WHERE attendance_date = CURDATE() AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance WHERE attendance_date = CURDATE() AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM homework_submission hs INNER JOIN homework h ON hs.homework_id = h.id AND h.is_deleted = 0 WHERE hs.submit_status IN (1, 2) AND hs.score IS NULL AND hs.is_deleted = 0

SELECT c.class_name AS className, COUNT(s.id) AS studentCount FROM class c LEFT JOIN student s ON c.id = s.class_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.class_name ORDER BY c.id

WITH RECURSIVE dates AS ( SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY AS dt UNION ALL SELECT dt + INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM dates WHERE dt < CURDATE() ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.dt, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(a.id), 0), 0), 1) AS rate FROM dates d LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.attendance_date = d.dt AND a.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY d.dt ORDER BY d.dt
